Class RowsModel

java.lang.Object
dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.RowsModel
public final class RowsModel extends Object
The RowsModel is associated with a RowSet. Using NavigateState and RowsAction it encapsulates RowSet traversal and their associated Actions which can be plugged into UI components; it broadcasts RowSet events.

RowsModelEvents are broadcast when the model's RowSet is changed and when the current RowSet notifies of eventsNextQ. RowSet eventsNextQ are coalesced when they occur in operations which are delineated by

  • startRowsEvent(RowsModel, Object)
  • finishRowsEvent(RowsModel)
Other/stray RowSet eventsNextQ are sent individually as soon as they are received.

      public static RowsModel create(RowSet rs, DbOps dbOps)

    • findDbOps

      public static DbOps findDbOps(RowSet rs, RowsModel rowsModel)
      Find DbOps for the specified RowSet. Looks for DbOpsCreator to create it; if not found or its create(rowSet) method returns null, then return new DbOps() {} which does nothing.
      Parameters:
      rs -
      rowsModel - where the RowSet is going, null if new RowsModel
      Returns:
      DbOps to use with this RowSet and RowsModel
